item.title: The most underrated quarterback in the NFL is the one on your team
item.description: Last month, The Athletic released Mike Sando’s Quarterback Tiers — the definitive annual survey assessing NFL quarterbacks, according to a panel of NFL coaches, executives and other insiders. Quarterback Tiers has been going strong for more than a decade. But this year, we tried something new: We invited readers to weigh in, too, by giving them an option to place quarterbacks in the tier where they thought they belonged, ranging from Tier 1 (elite, franchise quarterbacks) to Tier 5 (not an NFL starter). item.title: What I'm seeing from the Steelers: Fast start for Aaron Rodgers, 2 first-time Pro Bowlers
item.description: Congratulations. If you’re reading this, you’ve made it through the Steelers’ third coaching change since 1969, an offseason of Aaron Rodgers’ indecision, the four-quarterback preseason debates, and the ongoing Joey Porter Jr. negotiations. As we count down the hours until kickoff, friends and family members keep asking me the same question: “What do you think about the Steelers this year?” Answering in a few words isn’t easy.
